description: Erection of a front dormer roof extension, following the removal of 3no. rooflights in the front roofslope; installation of a rooflight, on top of the main flat roof at roof level; replacement of existing slates with new slates to the main roof slopes; re-sizing and replacement of a window within existing dormer window frame to the rear roofslope; erection of raised side and rear parapet walls to the rear outrigger to facilitate the formation of a roof terrace, including obscure-glazed openings within the parapet.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall not commence later than the expiration of 3 years beginning with the date of this planning permission.

Condition required to be imposed by section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended by section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in complete accordance with the following approved drawings, other than where those details are altered pursuant to the conditions of this planning permission:

A3/06 Revision B;
A3/07 Revision B; and
A3/08 Revision B

To ensure full compliance with the planning application hereby approved and to prevent harm arising through deviations from the approved plans.
Condition : 3 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the materials details (including colour and finish) specified below:

- Walls: London stock brick to match the existing building in terms of brick and mortar colour and bond pattern.

- Roof extensions: Natural or artificial slates/tiles which shall match the colour, shape and size of the existing roof.

- Windows: Timber frames, colour and finish to match the existing openings. 

- Doors: Timber to match the existing openings. 

- Terrace balustrade: Glass to a minimum level of obscurity equivalent to Pilkington Texture Glass Level 3

The development shall be permanently retained in accordance with the approved details. Any works of making good to existing elevations shall be carried out in materials to match the elevation to which the works relate.

To ensure a satisfactory external appearance, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).


Condition : 4 - The terrace hereby approved shall not be first used until the privacy screening has been installed as shown on approved drawing nos. A3/07 Revision B and A3/08 Revision B. The privacy screen shall achieve a minimum level of obscurity equivalent to Pilkington Texture Glass Level 3 and shall have a height of 1.7m above the finished floor level of the terrace along the side and rear elevations. The privacy screen shall thereafter be permanently retained as approved.

To protect the amenities of neighbouring occupiers in terms of overlooking and privacy in accordance with Policy HO11 of the Local Plan (2018).
